features.title: Multimodal references
features.what: The model accepts images video and audio as references.
features.evidence_quote: Ref2VA accepts up to **9 images, 3 videos and 3 standalone audio clips**

features.title: Reference guided editing
features.what: A prompt can guide generation using reference media.

features.title: Hosted audio stems
features.what: The hosted API can produce separate audio stems.

features.title: Native versus hosted resolution
features.what: Local generation is native at 480p or 768p while upscaling is hosted.
features.evidence_quote: Local open-weight inference supports native 480p / 768p video with mixed stereo audio.

risks.text: Hosted upscaling and audio stems may cost money; output quality is not guaranteed
